rca of the issue: Original bug (Scenario 2): RightDashboard PerJobTable allocated by hardcoded weight basis and By-Weight silently fell back to Equal because the Matched-Set engine path did NOT pass shipWeight into items_for_slot, so engWeight was missing/zero downstream. Fix (verified): backend engine_routes.py _alloc_job now threads shipWeight into items_for_slot at L1026; frontend buildScenarioMatrix captures engOMSF/engWeight per component; FreightDashModal.PerJobTable picks the right basis from allocMethod and detectFreightMinimum surfaces the LTL minimum banner. Regression test (this iteration): all three methods produce 3 distinct freight tuples, no two methods collapse to the same values, column header label flips correctly. Verified PASS.
